decisions.question: Coordinator session persistence model: How should the coordinator handle long-running tasks that exceed a single Claude session?

options.label: Checkpoint/resume
options.description: Save state to orchestrator at key points; resume from state after crash (builds on existing checkpoint infra)

options.label: Stateless polling
options.description: Coordinator is ephemeral; re-spawned periodically to poll orchestrator state and take next action

options.label: Long-running session
options.description: Accept context limits; design coordinator prompts to be compact enough for a single session

decisions.question: Phase model for coordinator-driven pipelines: Should the coordinator operate within the existing phase system, outside it, or in hybrid mode?

options.label: Within existing phases
options.description: Dynamic phase selection within REFINE→PLAN→IMPLEMENT→PR (can skip but phases still exist)

options.label: Outside phases
options.description: New freeform execution model with its own permission model

options.label: Hybrid
options.description: Phases exist but are advisory; coordinator can skip/reorder freely with a fallback permission model

decisions.question: Coordinator authority level: What should the coordinator be able to do without human approval?

options.label: Full autonomy
options.description: Spawn agents, skip phases, loop back, create PRs without approval (human reviews PR at the end)

options.label: Checkpoint approval
options.description: Autonomous within a phase but requires approval at phase boundaries

options.label: Supervised
options.description: Every significant decision (agent spawn, phase skip, loopback) requires human approval

decisions.question: Scope of initial implementation: How much of the coordinator system should be built in the first iteration?

options.label: Full system
options.description: Coordinator agent + MCP server + Claude Code integration + async triggers

options.label: Core only
options.description: Coordinator agent + orchestrator API extensions (MCP server in follow-up)

options.label: Prototype
options.description: Coordinator agent with manual CLI interaction only (validate concept first)

questions.question: What cost limits or guardrails should be applied to coordinator sessions? (e.g., max agents per task, max total token budget, max wall-clock time)
What should happen when the coordinator session crashes mid-task with running agents? (e.g., running agents continue and auto-commit, new coordinator is spawned to assess state, human is notified)
Should the coordinator be able to manage multiple related issues simultaneously, or is one-issue-at-a-time sufficient for v1? Are there specific multi-task scenarios you want supported?
